voz.estilo: Speak in American English like an intense, gripping narrator of a real police chase show. Urgent, punchy, fast pace, short dramatic pauses.

frases: December 2, 2025. Eastern Pacific.
A go-fast boat loaded with packages runs from the U.S. Coast Guard.
A helicopter crew moves in and disables the engines.
Then the cutters close in.
More than twenty thousand pounds of narcotics.
The Coast Guard's biggest single seizure at sea in over eighteen years.
Would you run?
videos.caption: The Coast Guard's biggest at-sea drug bust in 18 years: 20,000+ lbs. Real footage. #coastguard #chase #drugbust #police #realfootage

frases: May 2026, off Puerto Rico.
A small boat with three people and visible packages heads for the coast.
A Black Hawk and two interceptor boats go after it.
The suspects try to throw the packages overboard.
Agents recover the bales anyway.
Three hundred ninety-one pounds of cocaine. Three arrested.
Bad plan.
videos.caption: A Black Hawk chase off Puerto Rico ends with 391 lbs of cocaine and 3 arrests. Official CBP footage. #chase #police #cocaine #blackhawk #realfootage

frases: May 8, 2026. Eighty miles off Cartagena, Colombia.
This is the view from a Coast Guard interdiction helicopter.
The target: a suspected drug smuggling boat.
The helicopter stops it cold.
That patrol seized more than six thousand pounds of narcotics.
Worth nearly forty-six million dollars.
videos.caption: The view from a Coast Guard helicopter chasing a drug boat off Colombia. $45.8M seized. #coastguard #chase #drugbust #police #realfootage

frases: May 3, 2026. Off Andros, Bahamas.
A Coast Guard plane tracks a suspected drug boat in the dark.
On thermal, you can see everything.
The Royal Bahamas Defence Force closes in.
Three suspects stopped. Almost two thousand six hundred pounds of marijuana.
They thought the night would hide them.
videos.caption: A drug boat thought the dark would hide it. The thermal camera saw everything. #coastguard #chase #police #thermal #realfootage
